Proposed sales tax hike could fund new passenger rail line from Pueblo to Fort Collins
results.description: (COLORADO SPRINGS) — The Front Range Passenger Rail District is considering referring a 0.333% sales tax hike to voters to fund a passenger rail line connecting Pueblo to Fort Collins. Known as the Colorado Connector, or CoCo, the proposed rail service would establish regional passenger transit across the Front Range corridor. Funding is already secured [...]
